releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.31

- Subtitles now find the right film or episode. The app was searching by title,
  which returned thousands of unrelated results (or none at all for a Spanish
  show name); it now asks by the film's own id. A second subtitle site, SubDL,
  has been added on top for wider coverage.
- Series pages have a Resume button at the top showing the exact episode you left
  off on, so you no longer have to scroll the episode list to find your place.
  Open in External Player and Cast via VLC are there too, like on movies.
- Watched ticks now agree across your devices. An episode watched on one device
  showed no tick on another, and finishing something on the TV could remove it
  everywhere. Watched items also leave Continue Watching on every device now.
- Hold a movie poster to mark it watched or unwatched.
- Locked items and locked folders no longer show up in search, and a locked
  folder's contents are properly hidden everywhere.
